title: What's new in Bondrail
lines: Since our Metropolis submission, Bondrail has grown from revenue bonds into a full credit layer on Monad. Here's what's new — all live on testnet.

title: One deposit. A portfolio of bonds.
lines: First: vaults. Instead of picking bonds one by one, investors can deposit once and own a share of a portfolio of revenue bonds, managed by a disclosed curator under fixed limits.
Anyone can create a vault through the factory; Bondrail lists them all, and says plainly that it doesn't endorse curators.
Depositing shows exactly what you get before you sign — your shares at today's price, and how much cash can be withdrawn right now.
Healthy bonds are carried at cost; if a bond's revenue falls or it defaults, the exit price writes it down automatically. Your position appears in your portfolio within seconds.

title: A payment with a proven payer
lines: Second: paid API calls now settle straight through the business's Bondrail account.
The payer's own x402 signature is submitted to the account, so the payment is recorded with a proven payer, and the investors' share is split in the same transaction — on Monad.

title: Every bond explains itself
lines: Third: every bond now explains itself. One sentence says what was raised, what investors receive and how much has been repaid; a timeline shows where the bond is in its life; and you can see what one claim is worth now, by maturity, and if revenue stops.
Bonds can also carry a performance trigger — if revenue falls below an agreed level, the investors' share steps up when the trigger is checked. And every page says plainly how you could lose money.

title: A credit record other lenders can read
lines: Fourth: on-chain credit profiles. Each business's record — revenue, payers and repayment history — is readable on-chain, with a signed attestation that other lenders can verify.

title: Build on Bondrail
lines: And for builders, Bondrail is now on npm: the SDK for apps and agents, and the Solidity contracts — inherit BondrailEarner and your fees route through a revenue account from day one.

title: Credit for onchain businesses
lines: Bondrail: credit for onchain businesses, repaid in the same block they earn. Try it at bondrail.vercel.app — testnet, not audited.
